best_idea: Give each render group a face budget that is shared across the visible models each frame, smooth its ratio over 50 frames with a 10% overshoot guard, and pick LOD slots from a fitted line so a crowd degrades gracefully instead of stalling.
decision_why: Per-group budget, smoother with overshoot guard, and slot pick with a floor fit phone frame pacing without touching fight rules; change the unit to measured frame time, make the per-model budget pure (defect 1 fixed), and give the target ring its own group; no code is ported (AGPL, clean-room).
acceptance: In a crowd scene with the 3 attackers and a target ring, the triangle total stays within 110% of the wanted count across a 2 s camera sweep at phone width, and the target ring keeps its finest slot on every frame.
